test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Sonal is sitting second to the right of Lavanya. Rana is sitting second to the right of Sonal. Karishma is sitting third to the right of Rana. Mary is an immediate neighbour of both Rana and Sonal. Who is sitting immediate right of Kumari?
solution:
According to the given information we have: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Step 1): Sonal (S) is sitting second to the right of Lavanya (L). Rana (R) is sitting second to the right of Sonal. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4b032d8babc5f23fa074e8de8301873a95ab78b4b94e5f0226b9c23aad45433.png] 

Step 2): Karishma (Ka) is sitting third to the right of Rana (R). Mary (M) is an immediate neighbour of both Rana and Sonal. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c114849de6c5c2e3a5eb1863838f73e7483c52ab77ccf3ba1f73860f78c1c7b8.png] 

Step 3): Thus, the final arrangement is as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8accd798dfcda01dc579496f266510b9f23f426857baeeb2c0ebb1a8d6bc9256.png] 

Thus, **Lavanya (L)** is sitting immediate right of Kumari (Ku).

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
